title: 会飞的特斯拉，到底能飞多久？
title_en: Tesla's flying Roadster: how long can it really fly?

segments.zh: 昨天，美国得州，一辆白色跑车开上了一条倒挂的轨道。
segments.en: Yesterday in Texas, a white sports car drove onto an upside-down track.

segments.zh: 它头朝下开过去，翻个身，稳稳落地。
segments.en: It drove across upside down, flipped over, and landed.

segments.zh: 然后，它从五辆车的头顶上，“飞”了过去。
segments.en: Then it "flew" over the roofs of five cars.

segments.zh: 马斯克说：这就是将来真正上路的那辆车。
segments.en: Musk said: this is the actual car that will be on the roads.

segments.zh: 网上吵翻了：这是真飞，还是跳得很有派头？
segments.en: The internet split: real flight, or a very stylish jump?

segments.zh: 今天我们不站队，我们算账。八分钟，把这辆车拆开看看。
segments.en: Today we don't take sides. We do the math. Eight minutes to take this car apart.

segments.zh: 先认识一下今天的主角：小 R，一辆有点紧张的跑车。
segments.en: Meet today's star: R, a slightly nervous sports car.

segments.zh: 第一个黑科技：倒着开，为什么掉不下来？
segments.en: Trick one: driving upside down, why doesn't it fall?

segments.zh: 答案在车底：几台大风扇，拼命把车底下的空气往外抽。
segments.en: The answer is underneath: fans pump the air out from under the car.

segments.zh: 车底的空气变稀了，车顶上的大气还在使劲压。一上一下差出来的这股力，就把车按在路面上。
segments.en: Thin air below, the whole atmosphere pressing above: the difference pins the car to the road.

segments.zh: 这招叫“风扇车”，一点也不新。
segments.en: It's called a fan car, and it isn't new.

segments.zh: 1978 年，F1 有一辆赛车屁股上装了个大风扇，只比了一场，就赢了。
segments.en: In 1978, an F1 car with a giant fan on its back raced once, and won.

segments.zh: 然后就被叫停了。对手说它像个吸尘器，还把石子往后喷。
segments.en: Then it was pulled. Rivals called it a vacuum cleaner that sprayed stones behind it.

segments.zh: 关键在这里：机翼要靠速度才有下压力，风扇不用。车停着不动，也能把自己吸住。
segments.en: Here's the key: wings need speed to make downforce, fans don't. Even standing still, the car sticks.

segments.zh: 所以，只要吸力比车重还大，天花板就成了地板。
segments.en: So once the suction beats the car's weight, the ceiling becomes the floor.

segments.zh: 特斯拉屏幕上显示的吸力，约四千七百公斤，可能是车重的两倍多。
segments.en: Tesla's screen showed about 4,700 kg of downforce, maybe more than twice the car's weight.

segments.zh: 连科技媒体都说，这个数字可能有点水分。另一辆风扇车，一吨来重，号称两吨吸力，已经够吓人了。
segments.en: Even tech press suspect it's inflated. Another fan car, about a ton, claims two tons, which is already wild.

segments.zh: 第一个黑科技，打分：真本事。
segments.en: Trick one gets a score: the real thing.

segments.zh: 第二个黑科技：零到一百公里，只要一秒。
segments.en: Trick two: zero to sixty in one second.

segments.zh: 算一下：一秒加到每小时九十六公里，等于每秒提速二十七米，差不多是两点七个重力加速度。
segments.en: Do the math: 96 km/h in one second is 27 meters per second, every second. About 2.7 g.

segments.zh: 问题是，车靠轮胎抓着地面往前推。抓得再紧，最多也就一个多 g。
segments.en: But a car pushes off the road through its tires, and even great tires top out at one-point-something g.

segments.zh: 怎么办？两招。
segments.en: So what now? Two tricks.

segments.zh: 第一招，还是风扇：车被按得越紧，轮胎抓得越牢。
segments.en: First, the fans again: the harder the car is pressed down, the better the tires grip.

segments.zh: 第二招更狠：干脆不靠地面。车屁股后面，向后喷气。
segments.en: Second, more brutal: don't rely on the road at all. Blow gas out the back.

segments.zh: 这就是火箭的原理：把东西往后扔，自己就往前走。
segments.en: That's how a rocket works: throw stuff backward, and you go forward.

segments.zh: 据报道，后面四个喷口加起来，约八万牛顿推力。一辆两吨的车，光靠喷气，就有四个 g。
segments.en: Reportedly, the four rear jets make about 80 kilonewtons. For a two-ton car, that alone is 4 g.

segments.zh: 不过，还没有独立测量，这个“一秒”，我们先打个问号。
segments.en: No independent measurement yet, so that 'one second' gets a question mark.

segments.zh: 第三个，也是今天的重头戏：它到底能飞多久？
segments.en: Trick three, the main event: how long can it actually fly?

segments.zh: 它喷的不是火，是压缩空气。官方说，车上有六百升压缩空气，供十个喷口用。
segments.en: It doesn't burn anything. It blows compressed air: Tesla says 600 liters feed ten jets.

segments.zh: 六百升听起来很多？其实也就三个浴缸。
segments.en: 600 liters sounds like a lot? It's about three bathtubs.

segments.zh: 压得越狠，装得越多。官方没说压力，我们按常见的高压气罐估一估：大约能装两三百公斤空气。
segments.en: Tesla didn't give the pressure. Assuming a typical high-pressure tank, that's roughly 200 to 300 kilograms of air.

segments.zh: 冷空气喷出去，最快也就每秒几百米。要顶出八万牛的推力，每秒得喷掉一百多公斤。
segments.en: Cold air jets out at a few hundred meters per second at most. For 80 kN, you burn over 100 kilos every second.

segments.zh: 两三百公斤，每秒一百多公斤。全力喷，一两秒，推力就掉得差不多了。
segments.en: Two or three hundred kilos, over a hundred per second: at full blast, the thrust is mostly gone in a second or two.

segments.zh: 那不全力，只是把车托在半空悬停呢？两吨的车，要两万牛推力，每秒吃掉三十多公斤空气。
segments.en: What about just hovering? Holding up two tons takes 20 kN, eating over 30 kilos of air a second.

segments.zh: 而且越喷，罐里压力越低，推力越小，最后托不住了。
segments.en: And as it empties, pressure and thrust drop, until it can't hold the car.

segments.zh: 还有一个看不见的敌人：冷。
segments.en: There's also an invisible enemy: cold.

segments.zh: 气体一膨胀就会变冷。你按住喷雾罐不放，罐子会越来越冰手，就是这个道理。
segments.en: Expanding gas gets cold. Hold down a spray can and it turns icy. Same thing.

segments.zh: 罐子一冷，压力掉得更快，喷口还可能结霜。所以真实的飞行时间，只会比我们算的更短。
segments.en: A colder tank loses pressure even faster, and nozzles can frost up. So real airtime would be even shorter than our estimate.

segments.zh: 不信？我们做了一个虚拟实验，你可以自己调。
segments.en: Don't believe us? We built a virtual lab. Try it yourself.

segments.zh: 三百个大气压，悬停三米：五秒左右。
segments.en: 300 atmospheres, hover at three meters: about five seconds.

segments.zh: 压到七百个大气压：十秒左右。
segments.en: Squeeze it to 700: about ten seconds.

segments.zh: 再把车减掉五百公斤：也就十二秒多。
segments.en: Then cut 500 kilos off the car: just over twelve.

segments.zh: 所以结论是：它不是“飞”，是一次很贵的“跳”。
segments.en: So the verdict: it doesn't fly. It does a very expensive jump.

segments.zh: 不过，跳得有派头，也是真功夫。它在空中是怎么翻跟头的？
segments.en: Still, a stylish jump takes real skill. How does it flip in mid-air?

segments.zh: 秘密是：喷口不对准重心。推力偏一点，就变成让车转动的力，叫力矩。
segments.en: The secret: the jets don't point through the center of mass. Off-center thrust turns the car. That's torque.

segments.zh: 前面喷、后面不喷，车头就抬起来；左边喷、右边不喷，车就打滚。
segments.en: Fire the front but not the back, and the nose lifts. Fire the left but not the right, and it rolls.

segments.zh: 十个喷口一起配合，就能在空中“开”车。火箭回收落地，用的也是这一套。
segments.en: Ten jets working together let it steer in the air. Rockets that land themselves use the same trick.

segments.zh: 再烧一点脑：同样托起两吨，直升机能在天上待一个小时，喷口为什么只能撑几秒？
segments.en: A brain-burner: a helicopter holds up two tons for an hour. Why do jets last only seconds?

segments.zh: 关键是：推力，是“喷出去的空气乘速度”；花掉的力气，却是“空气乘速度的平方”。
segments.en: Key: thrust is air times speed, but the energy you spend is air times speed squared.

segments.zh: 少量空气喷得飞快，推力一样，力气却花得多得多；大量空气慢慢往下推，最省力。
segments.en: Blasting a little air very fast wastes energy. Gently pushing lots of air is efficient.

segments.zh: 直升机的大旋翼，就是在慢慢推一大片空气。算一下，托起同样两吨，小喷口要的功率，大约是十米旋翼的三十倍。
segments.en: A big rotor gently pushes a huge column of air. For the same two tons, small jets need about thirty times the power of a ten-meter rotor.

segments.zh: 所以你看，真正在做飞行汽车的公司，造出来的都长着螺旋桨。
segments.en: That's why the companies actually building flying cars all put propellers on them.

segments.zh: 第三个黑科技，打分：物理没错，但它是表演，不是交通工具。
segments.en: Trick three gets a score: right physics, but it's a stunt, not transportation.

segments.zh: 好，假设你就坐在里面。
segments.en: OK, suppose you're sitting in it.

segments.zh: 起步四个 g，相当于过山车最猛的那一下，还要再猛一点。
segments.en: Launching at 4 g is like the wildest moment on a roller coaster, and then some.

segments.zh: 翻跟头的时候头朝下，血往脑袋里冲。科技媒体都在问：要不要穿战斗机飞行员的抗荷服？
segments.en: Upside down, blood rushes to your head. Tech press ask: will you need a fighter pilot's g-suit?

segments.zh: 再看车里：每一个空隙，都塞满了碳纤维缠绕的高压气罐。
segments.en: And inside: every spare gap is packed with carbon-fiber-wrapped high-pressure tanks.

segments.zh: 这种罐子又轻又结实，但 SpaceX 几次火箭出事，都和这类罐子有关。
segments.en: They're light and strong, but this type of tank has been linked to SpaceX rocket failures.

segments.zh: 还有一道算术题：把六百升充满，最理想也要二十多度电，够这辆车跑一百多公里。
segments.en: And a sum: filling those 600 liters takes, ideally, over 20 kWh, enough to drive this car over 100 km.

segments.zh: 还有路边的人：据报道，演示时喷气卷起的碎石沙子，能飞出几十米。
segments.en: And bystanders: reportedly, the blast threw gravel and sand tens of meters during the demo.

segments.zh: 所以这些动作，只能在封闭场地里做。
segments.en: So these stunts belong on a closed course.

segments.zh: 马斯克自己说：安全不是主要目标；他们会“争取不害死任何人”。
segments.en: Musk himself said safety is not the main goal, and they will 'aspire not to kill anyone'.

segments.zh: 这两句是原话，我们不加评论。
segments.en: Those are his words. No comment from us.

segments.zh: 那这辆车，到底是什么？
segments.en: So what is this car, really?

segments.zh: 吸地：真本事，七十年代就有，现在做得更猛。
segments.en: The suction: real, around since the seventies, now turned up.

segments.zh: 一秒破百：物理上说得通，等独立测量。
segments.en: The one-second sprint: physically plausible, awaiting independent tests.

segments.zh: 飞：几秒钟的表演。很酷，但别指望它带你上班。
segments.en: The flying: a few seconds of show. Cool, but it won't fly you to work.

segments.zh: 时间表：说是 2028 年量产。这辆车 2017 年就发布过，之后推迟了一次又一次。
segments.en: Timeline: production in 2028. It was first unveiled in 2017 and delayed again and again.

segments.zh: 最后一个彩蛋：马斯克说，也许会开着它飞越蛇河峡谷。
segments.en: One last easter egg: Musk said it might jump the Snake River Canyon.

segments.zh: 1974 年，有个特技演员骑着火箭摩托试过。降落伞提前打开，他飘进了峡谷底。
segments.en: In 1974 a stuntman tried it on a rocket bike. His parachute opened early, and he drifted into the canyon.

segments.zh: 要是小 R 真飞过去了，我们再做一期。
segments.en: If R actually makes it, we'll make another episode.

segments.zh: 友情提示：吸力、一秒破百、六百升是特斯拉的说法；八万牛推力来自媒体报道；能装多少空气、能飞几秒、要多少电，是我们按常见数值做的估算。
segments.en: Note: the suction, the one-second sprint and 600 liters are Tesla's claims; 80 kN is from press reports; air mass, airtime and energy are our own estimates.
